Repository: https://github.com/tursodatabase/turso

Intended fork: https://github.com/laputa-systems/turso (not yet created; the owner creates and pushes it).

Base: 9e928387c549fb3c303c902b741918039a4e4dc4 (2026-11-25, 0.9.0-pre.6).

Branch: manganese/chromium-sqlite. Local commits: the vendor/turso commits on the Manganese lane branch lane/m3-sqlite, replayed by the owner into the clone.

The snapshot holds the crates Manganese builds: core (turso_core), ast (turso_ast), macros (turso_macros), sqlite/parser (turso_parser), sqlite/frontend (turso_sqlite) and extensions/core (turso_ext), with the upstream license files.
